contract_and_boundary: Available: typed decomposition and continuation-preserving transport. Packet completeness, kernels, profiles and admissible coefficient domains must match.
Available: accessible evidence initializes the distinctions needed by future use and correction. A quotient's existence does not supply its initializer.
Available in specified models: observable prediction can avoid full-state identification. Candidate-model scope, probability validity and initialization remain explicit.
Available: prediction and Bayesian correction descend under stated compatibility. Positivity, likelihood fibers and evidence normalization cannot be dropped.
Proposed learned bridge. A finite declared-table interface exists, but general causal, continuation-preserving learned translation is not established.
Available as a contract: the actual typed recipient must execute the transmitted method within its own bounds. A decoder designed after the fact is a different contract.
Available conditionally: pass the same posterior object and its output error into a specified decision model. A one-observation Gaussian theorem does not imply a general sequential filter.
Available: acquisition, explanation and repair require one workflow satisfying its complete resource profile. Reusable methods and discovery procedures are different targets.
Partial: both supply explicit admission obligations. A complete refinement proof linking all generated source forms to the runtime remains separate.
Available at the specification level: retain dependencies, evidence and revision history. Dependency completeness and external premise adequacy are not inferred from hashes.
Additional hypotheses required: compatible shared state does not by itself create offices, authority, obligations or independent decision centers.
Available as an authority contract: an allowed local revision must preserve applicable institutional constraints. Formal capability does not authorize external control.
Architecture path, not completed hardware: Packet IR must preserve the same typed output contract, numerical precision and costs.
Scoped limitation: exact summaries and projections face model-specific obstructions. No unrestricted computational separation follows.
Open integration in the recovered handoff: checked proof construction and the world-action dispatcher remain distinct branches.
No unrestricted composition theorem is claimed. One realization must satisfy all invoked interfaces simultaneously, with common evidence, costs and authority.
